overall_summary: Analysis of the deduplicated FACTVERSE dataset reveals a clear preference for astronomy and space-based 'What If' scenarios and extreme planetary facts. Specifically, videos covering hypothetical planetary conditions (e.g., liquid diamond planets, burning ice, dark planets) and extreme cosmic phenomena generate significantly higher view velocities and engagement rates (likes-per-view) compared to standard biology, psychology, or historical facts. The winning formats utilize immediate curiosity gaps, sensory comparisons, and counterintuitive scale comparisons.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos like 'What If You Fell Into a Liquid Diamond Planet?' (IYuce8vaU3Y) and 'What If You Fell Into the Planet of Burning Ice?' (8KEl0_pJ_68) achieved high view counts (approx. 1,000+ views) with exceptional like ratios (up to 38 likes) compared to older static biological facts.
winning_patterns.action: Double down on high-concept cosmic 'What If' immersion scenarios that place the viewer directly into extreme extraterrestrial environments.

winning_patterns.evidence: Titles detailing bizarre planetary physics such as 'Venus Has a Day Longer Than Its Year' (A9Qa-RmuOr0), 'This Planet Rains Supersonic Rubies!' (QXuqYERlqSo), and 'The Planet Darker Than Coal: TrES-2b' (v1rrcZLdp4U) consistently pull the highest traction in the channel's portfolio.
winning_patterns.action: Continue sourcing lesser-known exoplanets with extreme physical properties (e.g., magnetic anomalies, impossible winds, bizarre orbital mechanics).

weak_patterns.evidence: Topics like 'Your Brain Can Create Fake Memories' (5AN7LUgqarc, 2fqaGqfsR4A) and general memory/song-stuck-in-head trivia underperform significantly, garnering minimal views (under 60) and zero engagement.
weak_patterns.action: Deprioritize standard psychology and brain-hack micro-shorts unless framed through a groundbreaking, highly cinematic sci-fi or extreme survival lens.

weak_patterns.pattern: Low-Stakes Animal Trivia Without Cinematic Survival Stakes
weak_patterns.evidence: Simple animal facts like 'Octopuses Have THREE Hearts' (AXAfwrzzEdU) yield flat performance compared to high-concept space phenomena.
weak_patterns.action: Shift animal content away from static trivia toward high-stakes cinematic animal survival or extreme adaptations.
